text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval for the installation of a designated on-street accessible loading zone to operate between the hours of 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m., daily on the south side of Hounslow Heath Road, between Laughton Avenue and St. Clair Avenue West.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Designated an accessible loading zone to be in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m., daily, on the south side of Hounslow Heath Road, between a point 111 metres west of Laughton Avenue and a point 11 metres further west. 2. Amended the existing maximum one-hour parking regulation in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Saturday, on the west side of Hounslow Heath Road, between a point 33.2 metres south of St. Clair Avenue West and a point 30 metres west of Laughton Avenue, to be in effect between a point 33.2 metres south of St. Clair Avenue West and a point 122 metres west of Laughton Avenue and between a point 30 metres west of Laughton Avenue and a point 81 metres further west.
